svg.title: MUNITE — Kyeongmin Yeo and Minhyuk Sung, KAIST
svg.desc: Unified Multimodal Latent Inference for Any-to-Any Multimodal Generation. A schematic of marginal, conditional and full-observation inference through a shared latent space.

svg.title: One model, three observation regimes
svg.desc: The same Gaussian source format maps to a marginal latent distribution with no observations, a conditional distribution with partial observations, and one encoded latent with full observations. A separate example latent w is decoded into image, audio and text. This is a conceptual diagram.
